{{Citation}}
[[File:Falcon_rectenna.png|thumb|right|250px|The rectenna on the ''Millennium Falcon''.]]
{{Quote|Those rectennas are expensive!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="E25">[[Empire 25|''Empire'' 25]]</ref>}}
A '''rectenna''' was a large dish-shaped [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] and communication array installed on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Rectennas were commonly installed on [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ships]], which featured primary, auxiliary and backup rectenna<ref name="TPM Insider">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> and [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]] such as [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], which possessed an [[ANq-51 sensor array computer/Legends|ANq-51 sensor array computer]] and rectenna made by the [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] corporation that included both active and passive sensors, powerful jammers, intership transmitters, and short-range target acquisition systems. The ''Falcon''{{'s}} rectenna snapped off during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] due to the increasing tight spaces of the Death Star II and had to be replaced shortly after with a identical one.
